name: 83858 · Rathdrum, ID
findings: ZIP 83858 (Rathdrum) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83858 (Rathdrum) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
